# Environment variables

All settings are environment variables - there is no config file. This table is
generated from the source, so it cannot go stale.

| Variable | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `PIKDAME_ACCOUNTS` | unset (compare against `0`) | Set to `0` to disable user accounts entirely (pure guest play). |
| `PIKDAME_ALLOWED_ORIGIN` | unset | If set, only WebSocket connections from this origin are accepted (CSRF hardening). |
| `PIKDAME_BASE_URL` | the request's own host | Public base URL used to build invite links, QR codes and the links in mails (e.g. `https://play.example.com`). With SMTP configured, the year-review mail is only sent when this is set: its unsubscribe link must work. |
| `PIKDAME_BIRTHDAY` | — | Optional greeting days: comma-separated `MM-DD:account` entries (account = user name, case-insensitive). On that game day (German time) only that signed-in account sees a small greeting on the start screen; nobody else sees anything. Broken entries are skipped and logged by position. |
| `PIKDAME_DATA_DIR` | `<app>/data` | Directory for all persistent data (profiles, stats, accounts, session snapshot). Point this at your mounted volume. |
| `PIKDAME_DATABASE_PASSWORD` | unset | Password for the PostgreSQL connection (also readable from a `_FILE` secret; see Configuration). |
| `PIKDAME_DATABASE_URL` | unset | PostgreSQL connection string for accounts. If unset, a local SQLite file (`users.db`) inside the data directory is used. |
| `PIKDAME_HEARTBEAT_MS` | `30000` | WebSocket ping interval used to detect dead connections. |
| `PIKDAME_IMPRINT_CITY` | unset | Legal page: postcode and city. |
| `PIKDAME_IMPRINT_COUNTRY` | `Deutschland` | Legal page: country line. |
| `PIKDAME_IMPRINT_EMAIL` | unset | Legal page: contact address; shown only after a click, never as plain text in the HTML. |
| `PIKDAME_IMPRINT_NAME` | unset | Legal page (§ 5 DDG): provider name. With STREET, CITY and EMAIL required for a public site; while one is missing the page shows "Impressum nicht konfiguriert" and `/admin` warns. Kept out of the public repo on purpose. |
| `PIKDAME_IMPRINT_STREET` | unset | Legal page: street and number. |
| `PIKDAME_LOG_GAMES` | — | Set to `1` to log human moves to JSONL for imitation learning. |
| `PIKDAME_LOG_PATH` | `<app>/data` | Where the move log is written. |
| `PIKDAME_MAX_SESSIONS` | `500` | Maximum number of concurrent games. Beyond it, new games are rejected with "server full". |
| `PIKDAME_MODELS_DIR` | `models/` inside the image | Where the `.onnx` model files live. Override it to mount models on a volume and swap them without rebuilding the image. Default: the `models/` folder in the image. |
| `PIKDAME_ONNX` | — | Three-valued. **Unset = auto**: the trained ONNX bot policy is used whenever the runtime and the models are both present, and silently falls back to the heuristic where they are not. `1` forces it on (and says so loudly if it cannot be honoured), `0` forces the heuristic. See {doc}`onnx`. |
| `PIKDAME_PUBLIC_MODE` | unset (compare against `1`) | Set to `1` on a public server: no player profiles are persisted and the lobby shows no player list. Anonymous global stats are still counted. |
| `PIKDAME_TRUST_PROXY` | unset (compare against `1`) | Set to `1` when running behind a reverse proxy so client IPs are read from `X-Forwarded-For`. |
| `PIKDAME_YEAR_REVIEW_PREVIEW` | unset (compare against `1`) | Set to `1` to offer the December year review in the app all year (local checks, screenshots). Not for production. The review mail keeps its own date (27 December, 10:00 German time). |
| `PORT` | `8080` | HTTP/WebSocket port the server listens on. |

:::{note}
Secrets can also be supplied via a `*_FILE` variable pointing at a file (Docker
secrets), e.g. `PIKDAME_DATABASE_PASSWORD_FILE=/run/secrets/db_password`.
:::
